labels.comparisonUnavailable: No verified previous applicable version is available for comparison.
labels.machineComparison: Comparison of document bytes with the verified archive; this is not a reviewed account of changes.
labels.documentUnchanged: The document bytes are unchanged; other decision sources may differ.
labels.documentChanged: The document bytes differ. Read the presented version and the archived version when assessing the change.
labels.consequence: A decision applies only to this exact material. The Core confirms the permitted next step after saving.
labels.permission: Technical tool permission and this decision are separate. A host prompt may still appear.
labels.docUnavailable: The exact presented document is unavailable. No other version is substituted.
labels.commentRequired: Enter the requested changes before submitting.
labels.notSaved: No saved effect is confirmed. Reading and discussion do not decide.
labels.unknownCurrent: The saved effect is confirmed; the current state is unavailable.
labels.sourceLanguage: Source language is shown in the presentation.
labels.alreadyDecided: This material has already been decided. Follow the current Core result.
labels.initialize: Opening this view does not record a decision.

# PRD: Synthetic saved filter

Status: draft
Gate: PRD
Gate approval: open
Owner: Test product owner
Traceability contract: criteria-chain-v1

## Product Scope
Save and restore one named user-owned filter. No sharing or permissions change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-001
- requirement: Saving and restoring reproduces the selected filter values for the same user.
- observable_success: The restored filter values equal the saved values.

## Approval Decisions
| Decision | Timing | Status | Resolution | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Saved-filter ownership | before_prd | resolved | Only the saving user owns the filter | Test product owner |

## AGDF Approval Summary (de; source=en)
- Ziel: Einen persönlichen Filter speichern und wiederherstellen.
- Umfang: Ein benannter Filter ohne Freigabe für andere Nutzer.
- AC-001: Wiederherstellung reproduziert die gespeicherten Filterwerte desselben Nutzers.
- Entscheidungen: Persönliche Eigentümerschaft ist geklärt.

# PRD: Synthetic saved filter

Status: draft
Gate: PRD
Gate approval: open
Owner: Test product owner
Traceability contract: criteria-chain-v1

## Product Scope
Save and restore one named user-owned filter. No sharing or permissions change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-001
- requirement: Saving and restoring reproduces the selected filter values for the same user.
- observable_success: The restored filter values equal the saved values.

## Approval Decisions
| Decision | Timing | Status | Resolution | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Saved-filter ownership | before_prd | resolved | Only the saving user owns the filter | Test product owner |

## AGDF Approval Summary (de; source=en)
- Ziel: Einen persönlichen Filter speichern und wiederherstellen.
- Umfang: Ein benannter Filter ohne Freigabe für andere Nutzer.
- AC-001: Wiederherstellung reproduziert die gespeicherten Filterwerte desselben Nutzers.
- Entscheidungen: Persönliche Eigentümerschaft ist geklärt.

# PRD: Synthetic saved filter

Status: draft
Gate: PRD
Gate approval: open
Owner: Test product owner
Traceability contract: criteria-chain-v1

## Product Scope
Save and restore one named user-owned filter. No sharing or permissions change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-001
- requirement: Saving and restoring reproduces the selected filter values for the same user.
- observable_success: The restored filter values equal the saved values.

## Approval Decisions
| Decision | Timing | Status | Resolution | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Saved-filter ownership | before_prd | resolved | Only the saving user owns the filter | Test product owner |

## AGDF Approval Summary (de; source=en)
- Ziel: Einen persönlichen Filter speichern und wiederherstellen.
- Umfang: Ein benannter Filter ohne Freigabe für andere Nutzer.
- AC-001: Wiederherstellung reproduziert die gespeicherten Filterwerte desselben Nutzers.
- Entscheidungen: Persönliche Eigentümerschaft ist geklärt.

# PRD: Synthetic saved filter

Status: draft
Gate: PRD
Gate approval: open
Owner: Test product owner
Traceability contract: criteria-chain-v1

## Product Scope
Save and restore one named user-owned filter. No sharing or permissions change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-001
- requirement: Saving and restoring reproduces the selected filter values for the same user.
- observable_success: The restored filter values equal the saved values.

## Approval Decisions
| Decision | Timing | Status | Resolution | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Saved-filter ownership | before_prd | resolved | Only the saving user owns the filter | Test product owner |

## AGDF Approval Summary (de; source=en)
- Ziel: Einen persönlichen Filter speichern und wiederherstellen.
- Umfang: Ein benannter Filter ohne Freigabe für andere Nutzer.
- AC-001: Wiederherstellung reproduziert die gespeicherten Filterwerte desselben Nutzers.
- Entscheidungen: Persönliche Eigentümerschaft ist geklärt.

# PRD: Synthetic saved filter

Status: draft
Gate: PRD
Gate approval: open
Owner: Test product owner
Traceability contract: criteria-chain-v1

## Product Scope
Save and restore one named user-owned filter. No sharing or permissions change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-001
- requirement: Saving and restoring reproduces the selected filter values for the same user.
- observable_success: The restored filter values equal the saved values.

## Approval Decisions
| Decision | Timing | Status | Resolution | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Saved-filter ownership | before_prd | resolved | Only the saving user owns the filter | Test product owner |

## AGDF Approval Summary (de; source=en)
- Ziel: Einen persönlichen Filter speichern und wiederherstellen.
- Umfang: Ein benannter Filter ohne Freigabe für andere Nutzer.
- AC-001: Wiederherstellung reproduziert die gespeicherten Filterwerte desselben Nutzers.
- Entscheidungen: Persönliche Eigentümerschaft ist geklärt.

# SD: Synthetic saved filter
Status: draft
Gate: SD
Gate approval: open
Owner: Test design owner
Traceability contract: criteria-chain-v1
Design Decisions contract: sd-decisions-v1

## Solution Overview
Reuse the existing user-owned filter store.

## Ownership And Source Of Truth
Existing filter service retains ownership; the approved PRD remains product authority.

## Architecture Decisions
- SDD-001: Reuse the existing filter service; rationale: retain user ownership; consequence: no shared filters.

## Acceptance Traceability
| criterion_id | design_response | source_of_truth | design_decision_ids | compatibility_risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AC-001 | Existing store saves/restores owned filter values | Filter service and approved PRD owner | SDD-001 | Existing personal ownership retained |

## Design Decisions
| Decision | Timing | Status | Resolution | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Store boundary | before_sd | resolved | Existing filter service | Test design owner |

## AGDF Approval Summary (de; source=en)
- Lösung: Bestehenden persönlichen Filterspeicher wiederverwenden.
- Verantwortung: Filterservice und freigegebenes PRD.
- Entscheidungen: Bestehender Speicher mit persönlicher Eigentümerschaft.

Gate approval: open
Owner: Test design owner
Traceability contract: criteria-chain-v1
Design Decisions contract: sd-decisions-v1

## Solution Overview
Reuse the existing user-owned filter store.

## Ownership And Source Of Truth
Existing filter service retains ownership; the approved PRD remains product authority.

## Architecture Decisions
- SDD-001: Reuse the existing filter service; rationale: retain user ownership; consequence: no shared filters.

## Acceptance Traceability
| criterion_id | design_response | source_of_truth | design_decision_ids | compatibility_risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AC-001 | Existing store saves/restores owned filter values | Filter service and approved PRD owner | SDD-001 | Existing personal ownership retained |

## Design Decisions
| Decision | Timing | Status | Resolution | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Store boundary | before_sd | resolved | Existing filter service | Test design owner |

- Lösung: Bestehenden persönlichen Filterspeicher wiederverwenden.
- Verantwortung: Filterservice und freigegebenes PRD.
- Entscheidungen: Bestehender Speicher mit persönlicher Eigentümerschaft.

# SD: Synthetic saved filter
Status: draft
Gate: SD
Gate approval: open
Owner: Test design owner
Traceability contract: criteria-chain-v1
Design Decisions contract: sd-decisions-v1

## Solution Overview
Reuse the existing user-owned filter store.

## Ownership And Source Of Truth
Existing filter service retains ownership; the approved PRD remains product authority.

## Architecture Decisions
- SDD-001: Reuse the existing filter service; rationale: retain user ownership; consequence: no shared filters.

## Acceptance Traceability
| criterion_id | design_response | source_of_truth | design_decision_ids | compatibility_risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AC-001 | Existing store saves/restores owned filter values | Filter service and approved PRD owner | SDD-001 | Existing personal ownership retained |

## Design Decisions
| Decision | Timing | Status | Resolution | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Store boundary | before_sd | resolved | Existing filter service | Test design owner |

## AGDF Approval Summary (de; source=en)
- Lösung: Bestehenden persönlichen Filterspeicher wiederverwenden.
- Verantwortung: Filterservice und freigegebenes PRD.
- Entscheidungen: Bestehender Speicher mit persönlicher Eigentümerschaft.
